name: Algebra 1 Assessment / Evidence Philosophy — Derivative Retrieval Profile
authority_note: Exact Unit Assessment Plan HTML is authoritative; this profile makes recurring Algebra evidence philosophy easy to retrieve.

progress_language.Not Yet: learning outcome still developing; more practice, feedback, and evidence needed
progress_language.Approaching: growth toward mastery is visible; more evidence is needed for consistent mastery
progress_language.Meeting: sufficient evidence of mastering the learning outcome
progress_language.Exceeding: evidence of applying skills/concepts beyond the expected challenge of the learning outcome

evidence_rules: Professional judgment uses a body of evidence rather than simple averaging or latest-score-only rules.
Official Exit Tickets are rolling mastery evidence: 2 new + 2 previous-section reassessments.
A short ticket does not need to cover every supporting I Can when the coursewide evidence map distributes opportunities across sections and later evidence routes.
Targeted Intro/Review reteach or recovery checks may be generated on demand and are not automatically official portfolio events.
Quick Checks provide later deeper evidence; Summatives provide broader secure mastery evidence.
DOK describes completed thinking; it is not a quota engine.
